items.summary: The reliable processed reader is released with immutable-source access, labelled modes, structured apparatus, and responsive annotation expansion.
evidence: Local: 11 focused seeded Chromium reader checks passed for continuous processed text, footnote/bibliography separation, labels, outline/position controls, apparatus, evidence metadata, and accessible responsive expansion.
Production: Vercel and Render are live on the Phase 16 revision; an authenticated canary reader response exposed both the immutable PDF URL and processed extraction.
Production: the one-run PDF canary was full structure with 4 page-anchored footnotes, 13 apparatus records, and zero footnote-text matches in body blocks before complete cleanup.
